incident-bot: INCIDENT [P1] inference-cache-thundering detected in us-west-2. Paging oncall @maya. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident-1715070000. Please react with :eyes: when you join.

maya: Oncall here. Quick mitigation summary: scaled inference replicas from 4 -> 12, flushed stale KV entries for the problematic model shard, and throttled low-priority background jobs. Initial customer impact: brief elevated errors and 429s for some tenants. I'll paste short logs and commands below.

maya: ```bash
# what I ran
kubectl scale deploy/inference-runtime --replicas=12 -n prod
redis-cli -h cache-prod-1 --scan --pattern "model:*:kv:*" | xargs -r redis-cli -h cache-prod-1 del
# snapshot of recent errors
2024-04-15T10:12:33Z ERROR inference: failed to allocate KV cache: out of memory
2024-04-15T10:13:01Z WARN  router: backpressure triggered for route /v1/generate
```

luis: Thanks — can you confirm impacted customers + rough time windows? We need that for postmortem customer impact and ops comms.

maya: Affected customers (prelim): acme-inc (10:12-10:18 UTC), beta-corp (10:14-10:20 UTC), sandbox/test-traffic spike 10:11-10:16. Error rate peaked ~4.2% for the affected model route.

sam: I'll own the timeline & evidence census and draft the initial RCA. Will collect traces, cpu/mem graphs, HPA events, and request logs. Assigning to myself (@sam).

jordan: I'll schedule the postmortem meeting and send invites. Proposed: Thu Apr 18 15:00 PT. Also need ops + legal on the invite for customer comms signoff.

amelia: I'll scrub logs for PII and pull traces from the observability stack. Also will run quick evals on our prompt set to check for any quality regressions. @sam, can you link the evaluation prompt set you want me to use?

sam: Will do — uploading prompt set + telemetry links to the doc now. ETA: EOD today.

luis: Action items summary (please ack):
1) Timeline & draft RCA (owner: @sam) — due EOD today
2) Evidence census & PII scrub (owner: @amelia) — due EOD today
3) Autoscale / HPA tuning proposal (owner: @devon) — initial proposal by tomorrow
4) Customer comms draft (owner: @tess / ops) — draft after timeline + customer list
5) Postmortem meeting (owner: @jordan) — invite sent

devon: Ack. I'll review HPA events and pod vs node metrics. Initial plan: reduce CPU threshold to 60%, add a short-term burst buffer for KV intensive ops, and add a guard in the router to shed background traffic earlier. I'll post a PR for config changes.

tess: Ack. I'll start a draft comms template and wait for the confirmed customer list + durations. Will loop in legal if needed.

maya: Copied logs and snapshots here: https://artifacts.redwood/incident-1715070000/snapshot.tar.gz. Sample log excerpt: `2024-04-15T10:12:33Z ERROR inference: failed to allocate KV cache: out of memory`

sam: :thumbsup: Starting the doc now. Tagging reviewers: @luis, @amelia, @devon, @tess. Please peer-review by tomorrow noon so we can finalize customer comms.

incident-bot: Postmortem checklist created: https://rdo/pm/1715070000 (private). Status flags: timeline=todo, evidence=todo, impact=todo, mitigation=done. Update the checklist as you progress.

luis: Quick Q — any sign of model quality regression or output corruption during the window?

amelia: Ran a small eval on the seed set — no meaningful regression detected. Will include plots and diff metrics in the evidence folder.

maya: Handing off remaining oncall context to @jordan. Handover note: scaling + KV flush fixed the acute error rate; follow-ups needed on autoscale thresholds and router shedding.

sam: I'll assemble the first RCA draft (timeline, contributing factors, impact summary, remediation plan) and post link here when ready. Please call out any missing pieces.

luis: Thanks everyone — please update the central doc when you finish your pieces. We'll aim for peer-signoff by Friday so ops can approve customer comms.
